uiExemptions.reason: main/runtime-build.js lets cp create the staging directory; main/canvas-bundle.js settles asset requests before falling back. No renderer change; captured pictures still show the same UI (C084).
main/writer-admission.js hashes the native real path (Windows 8.3 short names). No renderer change (C084).
main/goal-process.js and main/goal-service.js: process-group containment for owned workers on POSIX. No renderer change (C084).
main/upstream-admission.js (new) and main/local-barkpark-source.js: trusted hold client and admission environment for the managed runtime. No renderer change (C083).

main/local-barkpark-source.js, main/runtime-build.js, main/external-resource.js and the new main/local-barkpark-launch.sh: POSIX twin of the managed-runtime launcher. No renderer change (C083/D-hosts).
main/upstream-admission.js: instance view and explicit recovery in the hold client. No renderer change (C083).
main/sealed-comparison.js (new): comparison under the upstream hold. No renderer change (C083).
main/migration-selection.js (new): durable Paper selection and rollback under both fences. No renderer change (C083).
main/migration-comparison.js exposes compareWithin; main/migration-selection.js uses it. No renderer change (C083).
main/documents.js, main/migration-selection.js, main/profile-service.js: legacy note store read-only after selection; authority in the profile view. No renderer change (C083).
